plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours and type on this design: your name as the letterhead over your own photograph of a suite, today's free homes from your own Google Sheet with the date each is free and its all-in price, a viewing request by WhatsApp, and the fees and terms page with your redress scheme.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: everything in Starter, the residences page with filters, quiet notes and "Send this quote" on every home, and pages such as short lets, long lets, what serviced means, arriving, areas and about.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. The showpieces: the stay bar under the photograph (a few nights to a long let, every fee in the total, the homes re-priced to the same stay), when the sun reaches each home's windows today, the neighbourhood guide, the concierge, corporate relocations, landlords and the journal.

gate.plus: Starter is the home page with today's homes, booking a viewing and the fees page. Plus adds pages like this one.
gate.signature: Signature adds the showpieces: the stay bar, the sun on the windows, the neighbourhood guide, the concierge and pages like this one.
